programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Extreme Deception Indicated

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Shocking Statement

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Teen Mom Murderer?

programme.desc: Holmes uncovers a serious mystery when helping one of Watson's old friends.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Sherlock Holmes

programme.title: The Adventures Of Sherlock Holmes

programme.title: The Adventures Of Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Visiting a home of high nobility, a businessman is murdered.

programme.title: A Horse Story
programme.desc: Monican hevonen Champion murtaa hevosten perinteen ja paljastaa, että hevoset osaavat puhua. Monica auttaa sitä selvittämään, minkälainen hevonen se haluaa olla isona. Samalla Monicalle selviää oikea tie elämässä.

programme.title: From Time To Time

programme.title: The Great Alaskan Race

programme.title: Zapped

programme.title: Buck and the Magic Bracelet

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Point of Destruction

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Death Cell
programme.desc: An escaped mental patient comes to Peter, asking for his help in getting her fiancͩ cleared of a murder charge as he awaits execution.

programme.desc: A European spy kills a British professor and steals vital papers. M.I.5 recruits Peter to go to to Amsterdam and recover the scientific research.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The Prize

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The White Rabbit

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Man in Disguise

programme.desc: Terrorists in an Italian market gun down a family. This sparks an investigation into how the killers got the guns, which Peter is tasked with.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Man in Power
programme.desc: Brady aids the heirs of a Middle East king, who has been murdered by his power-crazy army chief to regain their father's throne.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Shadow Bomb

programme.title: South Park: Hotter than Summer: Proper Condom Use
programme.desc: Proper Condom Use: After Cartman and Stan play "red rocket" with their dogs, their parents decide it's time for some school sex education. What the school provides creates worse problems! (S5, E07)
programme.sub-title: Hotter than Summer: Proper Condom Use

programme.title: South Park: Towelie
programme.desc: Towelie: Stan's mother buys the boys a console called The Okama Gamesphere but it is stolen whilst they are at school. To get it back they must help a talking towel take on the government! (S5, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants
programme.desc: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants: The boys send $1 to Afghan children and receive a goat back. When they try to return it an adventure ensues! First episode to air after 9/11. (S5, E09)
programme.sub-title: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants

programme.title: South Park: How To Eat With Your Butt
programme.desc: How To Eat With Your Butt: It's school photo time. Kenny decides to play a prank by wearing his parka upside down and revealing his buttocks. Cartman decides to take it a step further. (S5, E10)
programme.sub-title: How To Eat With Your Butt

programme.title: South Park: The Entity
programme.desc: The Entity: Kyle's annoying cousin arrives in town and it's not long before the boys are doing their best to get rid of him. Mr Garrison invents a slightly sexual new mode of transport. (S5, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Here Comes The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Here Comes The Neighbourhood: Token is picked on for being rich so decides to market the town as a millionaire's playground - cue Will Smith and Snoop Dogg moving in! Class war follows! (S5, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Kenny Dies
programme.desc: Kenny Dies: When Kenny is diagnosed with a terminal illness, Stan takes it especially hard. Will Cartman's truck load of foetuses help with a cure? Or does he have other plans for them... (S5, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Butter's Very Own Episode
programme.desc: Butters' Very Own Episode: Butters' mum asks him to spy on his dad, however what he discovers leaves Mrs Stoch acting slightly unhinged. Will this be the end of our lil blonde haired buddy? (S5, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Professor Chaos (Part 1)
programme.desc: Professor Chaos (1): Butters is sacked by the boys as their replacement best friend for Kenny - the hunt for a new friend is on! Out for revenge, Butters becomes... Professor Chaos! (S6, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Simpsons Already Did It (Part 2)
programme.desc: Simpsons Already Did It (2): Professor Chaos gets distraught as he realises all of his plans have already appeared on The Simpsons! Cartman gets very excited about growing Sea People. (S6, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Red Hot Catholic Love
programme.desc: Red Hot Catholic Love: A sexual abuse scandal involving priests hits South Park and is taken all the way to the Vatican. (S6, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Free Hat
programme.desc: Free Hat: Kyle, Stan, Cartman & Tweek get angry about Steven Spielberg and George Lucas' habit of altering their films with each "re-re-re-release". They go on a mission to steal the movies.(S6, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Bebe's B**bs Destroy Society
programme.desc: Bebe's B**bs Destroy Society: Returning from school break, all the boys notice something different about Bebe... out comes the primitive man as they fight to see who'll play with her! (S6, E10)

programme.title: South Park: A Ladder to Heaven
programme.desc: A Ladder To Heaven: The boys break into the McKormick house to try and find a winning ticket. Whilst there Cartman mistakenly drinks Kenny's ashes and starts to have some strange visions... (S6, E12)

programme.title: South Park: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers
programme.desc: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers: The boys are dressed up in full 'Middle Earth' gear, and are sent on a quest by Randy to deliver a video to Butter's parents. (S6, E13)
programme.sub-title: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers

programme.title: South Park: The Death Camp of Tolerance
programme.desc: The Death Camp of Tolerance: Mr. Garrison does what he can to get fired for being gay so he can sue the school for millions of dollars. (S6, E14)

programme.title: South Park: The Biggest Douche in the...
programme.desc: The Biggest Douche in the Universe: Cartman is rushed to hospital after again being possessed by Kenny. Chef believes a TV psychic can help but Stan isn't so sure... (S6, E15)

programme.title: South Park: My Future Self n' Me
programme.desc: My Future Self 'n' Me: After meeting his failed self from the future, Stan decides to avoid drink and drugs - but why does Butters also have a good-for-nothing future self staying with him? (S6, E16)

programme.title: South Park: Red Sleigh Down
programme.desc: Red Sleigh Down: Cartman's 'naughty or nice' accountant informs him that he has been too bad to earn his Christmas gift. All aboard Mr Hankey's Poo-Choo train for a trip to the North Pole! (S6, E17)

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Anita y su hijo se enfrentan a un demonio que usa un antiguo artefacto para abrir portales en su casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una familia sospecha que alguien merodea su casa y descubre la presencia de un fantasma que murió trágicamente en la propiedad. La situación se torna violenta. ¿Podrá la familia recuperar su casa antes de que sea demasiado tarde?

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Tras un escalofriante encuentro con una momia egipcia, un joven es perseguido por el ente para robarle el alma.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una adolescente experimenta con el ocultismo y la oscuridad es atraída a su casa de Alaska. El espíritu ataca a la familia y, al ver que sus vidas peligran, buscan la ayuda de expertos.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: El Hermano Capulina
programme.desc: Capulina abandona el digno oficio de limosnero, pero no por ello va a cometer la locura de trabajar. Va a dar a una orden de Frailes que se dedican a hacer la caridad y se enfrenta a los problemas de los Frailes y los de todos a su alrededor.

programme.title: El Investigador Capulina
programme.desc: Capulina confunde al vicepresidente de una empresa con un ladrón. Sus amigos los luchadores Tinieblas y Superzan acuden en su ayuda y evitan un asalto. Capulina creyéndose el héroe decide poner una agencia de investigadores.

programme.title: El bueno para nada

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT
programme.desc: ¿Los antiguos oráculos griegos eran realmente adivinos o solo predecían bajo la influencia de fenómenos tectónicos?

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT
programme.desc: Descubra si fueron fuerzas externas las que condenaron a la gente del Cañón del Chaco o si ellos mismos fueron los autores de su propia desgracia.

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT
programme.desc: Desde Camelot hasta la búsqueda del Santo Grial, aprende qué hay de cierto en el mito del Rey Arturo.

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT
programme.desc: Descubra asombrosos hallazgos sobre el Camino de Santiago mientras los científicos examinan los orígenes de los antiguos trayectos espirituales.

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT
programme.desc: Descubra los sorprendentes secretos sobre el poder político y sexual que poseían las mujeres del antiguo Egipto.

programme.desc: Acompañe a científicos de todo el mundo mientras estudian lugares sagrados que los nazis una vez afirmaron que fueron construidos por y para una antigua raza aria.

programme.title: MacGyver LT

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver lucha por su vida en una de sus aventuras más impresionantes mientras viaja a las junglas sofocantes de América del Sur, donde se encuentra con la terrible devastación causada por miles de millones de hormigas en el camino.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: El apuesto MacGyver es llevado al límite de sus innumerables trucos y métodos de escape únicos después de que unos ladrones despiadados incautan millones de dólares de un vehículo blindado y lo toman entre sus rehenes.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver revela asombrosos nuevos trucos de su inusual oficio para recuperar 60 millones de dólares en diamantes que fueron robados por un estafador brillante y sin escrúpulos.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: El rudo MacGyver se sumerge entre gases venenosos, una torre petrolífera que explota y el infierno del fuego cuando intenta ayudar a un viejo amigo a encontrar oro negro.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver lleva sus habilidades al límite tratando de evitar que una figura del inframundo mate a su propio hermano antes de que el hombre pueda testificar en su contra en la corte.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Cuando le dicen a MacGyver que se vaya de la ciudad rápido porque asesinos lo persiguen, tiene un reencuentro agridulce con su abuelo, a quien no ha visto en años y cuya vida también está en peligro.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver participa de un juego mortal contra un doble agente que utiliza el equipo electrónico más sofisticado del mundo en un intento de silenciar a MacGyver para siempre.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver batalla por su vida mientras lucha por recuperar una lista de terroristas en un microfilm pirata después de que le hayan inyectado un suero mortal.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver se enfrenta a un extorsionador brillante que ha colocado una bomba en un barco en un complot mortal para ganar varios millones de dólares.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver vive una de sus experiencias más horribles cuando intenta evitar que un reactor nuclear explote y contamine a una comunidad después de profundizar en tres extraños asesinatos.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver se une a una hermosa desertora cuando se le pide que identifique al doble agente responsable de la muerte de tres agentes.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver conoce a una hermosa mujer en Bulgaria, donde está contrabandeando microfilmes en una misión peligrosa, y es atrapado por los milicianos después de que la belleza desliza algunas joyas en su bolsillo.
programme.sub-title: Every Time She Smiles / Together Forever

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver, gravemente herido, se encuentra en el Afganistán dominado por los soviéticos y se hace amigo de un joven afgano que lo lleva a casa para recuperarse, pero es posible que MacGyver no tenga esa oportunidad.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver y un genio informático adolescente que ha obtenido información sobre tecnología de defensa ultrasecreta intentan detener una posible catástrofe nacional.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver se enfrenta a un desafío extraño y aterrador cuando los habitantes de una tierra desolada que buscan venganza lo toman como rehén a él y a todo un tren lleno de pasajeros temerosos.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver enfrenta una de sus aventuras más extenuantes y peligrosas cuando es encarcelado para ayudar a escapar al hermano de una mujer, pero pronto encuentra su propia vida en juego.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Chef reclama los derechos de la nueva canción de Alanis Morissette, ''Calzón Sucio'', pero de alguna forma termina siendo demandado. Ahora los chicos, Elton John y otros músicos tratan de juntar el dinero para ayudar a Chef.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey es despedido de la escuela por perder una hoja de marihuana durante una presentación en contra de las drogas. Entretanto, los chicos tratan de salvar a Ike de su fiesta ''bris'' en donde le harán la circuncisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kenny lleva a su novia a un concierto de los Jonas Brothers donde cada asistente recibe "anillos de castidad".

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los padres de Kenny son arrestados. Esto provoca que Kenny y sus hermanos vayan a una casa adoptiva con padres agnósticos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kenny es aplastado por la Estación Espacial Mir y se convierte en un zombi que desata la epidemia por todo el pueblo. Pero el doctor diagnostíca a todos como si tuvieran conjuntivitis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos ganan muchos dulces en un concurso, pero para reclamar el premio necesitan el cupón ganador el cual le dieron a Kenny antes de morir.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le cuenta a sus amigos sobre un extraño sueño que tuvo en donde unos ''visitantes'' lo abducen y le ponen una sonda anal. Pero al parecer, no fue sólo un sueño, ya que algo está desollando a las vacas del pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: ¡Parece que el Coon es más nefasto incluso que el Señor Oscuro, Cthulhu! Mientras que el Coon castiga a sus antiguos amigos, Kenny lucha con la maldición de su súper poderes a través de su alter ego, Mysterion.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman decide entrar en el negocio de la venta de fetos abortados. Por otro lado, Kenny contrae una enfermedad muscular mortal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La verdadera identidad de Mysterions es revelada. Mientras tanto, el Coon, despreciado por sus compañeros súper héroes, está en busca de venganza, y logra convencer a Cthulu para ser compañeros de equipo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos encuentran un antiguo objeto triangular en una excavación escolar. Luego de salir en el noticiero, Barbra Streisand aparece buscándolo ya que es lo que necesita para poder convertirse en un monstruo gigante japonés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En el homenaje de South Park a la película "Heavy Metal", los chicos tratan de que Kenny se libre de la última locura por las drogas que ha capturado a la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La ciudad de South Park está en crisis y Kenny piensa que es hora de conseguir un trabajo.
programme.sub-title: La ciudad que es parte del pueblo

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El abuelo de Stan cumple 102 años y quiere suicidarse, pero al no poder hacerlo, le pide a Stan que lo ayude.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Varios habitantes de South Park explotan sin razón aparente y Randy es el encargado de descubrir por qué. Por otro lado, los chicos tienen que representar las "Estaciones de la cruz" en misa, y Kyle trata de ''conseguir una erección''.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuento Southparkitero del libro "Grandes Esperanzas" de Dickens, teniendo como protagonista a Pip, un inglés de clase pobre, y con Malcolm McDowell, un británico como narrador.

programme.desc: Cartman se enoja porque Kenny consiguió una consola de videojuegos y él no. Pero Kenny muere al llegar al nivel 60, y va al cielo y se entera que Dios lo mató a propósito ya que lo necesitan para que salve al cielo de un ataque de Satanás.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En Halloween, los chicos quieren asustar a los de quinto grado, así que desentierran el cadáver de la abuela de Kyle. Mientras tanto, la banda Korn está en South Park y unos fantasmas piratas asechan a los habitantes.

Sixty years later, Hellboy serves as an agent in the Bureau of Paranormal Research and Defense, where he, aided by Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), a merman with psychic powers, and Liz Sherman (Selma Blair), a woman with pyrokinesis, protects America against dark forces.

programme.title: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: When Helen, a London ad executive, is fired from her job and rushes out to catch a train, two scenarios take place. In one, she gets on the train and comes home to find her boyfriend, Gerry, in bed with another woman. In the second, she misses the train and arrives after the woman has left. Following the first scenario, Helen dumps Gerry, finds a new man and gradually improves her life. Under the second scenario, she becomes suspicious of Gerry's fidelity and grows miserable.

programme.title: A Little Bit of Heaven
programme.desc: New Orleans ad executive Marley Corbett (Kate Hudson) is a free-spirited woman who embraces her easy sexuality, shuns commitment, and gains support and strength from a close circle of friends. Then Marley learns she has terminal colon cancer. Despite her determination not to be tied down in a serious relationship, Marley finds herself falling in love with her handsome doctor (Gael García Bernal), even as her health slowly deteriorates.

programme.title: Bewitched

programme.title: João Bosco
programme.desc: The vibrant island of Malta was in for a night of light and cheerful music when Brazilian music legend João Bosco took the stage on July 21, 2018. The self-taught guitarist made his music debut in the 1970s alongside Elis Regina and Aldir Blanc. In 2018, with guitarist Ricardo Silveira, bassist João Baptista and drummer Kiko Freitas, Bosco introduces us to his trademark melting pot of bossa nova, samba and MPB, sparingly influenced by contemporary jazz. Following his phenomenal successes in his native Brazil, the enthusiasm of the Maltese crowd underlines that João Bosco is now gradually achieving his long-overdue recognition elsewhere.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner, Avery Sharpe & Louis Hayes
programme.sub-title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner's first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson's and Art Farmer's Jazztet. He's also known for his work with the John Coltrane Quartet. Tyner's style is easily comparable to Coltrane's maximalist style of saxophone. Though a member of Coltrane's group, he was never overshadowed by the saxophonist, but complemented and even inspired Coltrane's open-minded approach. McCoy Tyner is considered one of the most influential jazz pianists of the 20th century, an honour he earned both with Coltrane and in his years of performing following Coltrane's death.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Jamie Cullum
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.sub-title: Brooks Bowman/Jazzmeia Horn, East Of The Sun
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Herbie Mann, Marc Cohen, Romero Lubambo & Paul Socolow
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1990, American flautist Herbert Jay Solomon, better known by his stage name Herbie Mann, was one of the artists appearing here. Together with Marc Cohen on piano, Romero Lubambo on guitar, Paul Socolow on bass, and both Ricky Sebastian and Cyro Baptista on percussion, Herbie Mann performs his infectious take on Brazilian-inspired music in this concert titled 'Jasil Brazz'.

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan, Richard Davis, Ronnell Bright & Art Morgan
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 & 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic. These three performances demonstrate why Sarah Vaughan is invariably mentioned in the same breath as Ella Fitzgerald and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
programme.sub-title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: Valery Gergiev
programme.desc: This visually stunning production of Nutcracker is a graceful and timeless adventure on a grand scale. From the lovely Waltz of the Flowers to the crystalline beauty of the stunning Snowflake Waltz, each scene is more breathtaking than the last, bringing to life all the well-known and beloved characters with fresh sparkle and compelling originality. It is Christmas Eve and we are brought to a party at which Drosselmeyer gives young Clara a nutcracker doll - beginning a night that includes a magically growing Christmas tree, a midnight battle of toy soldiers at which the Nutcracker defeats the villainous Mouse King and his army of mice, and a headlong pas de deux in which Clara and Hans-Peter meet and celebrate their triumph before being enveloped in a magical snowstorm. Act II whisks the young pair off to the Kingdom of the Sweets, where they are entertained by the Sugar Plum Fairy with her handsome Prince and her glittering court in a series of dazzling dances. Under the direction of Andreas Morell, Valery Gergiev conducts the Mariinsky Orchestra and Choir. Soloists are Mikhail Makarov, lldar Abdrazakov, Anna Markarova, Sergei Skorokhodov, Timur Abdikeyev, Vladislav Sulimasky. This production was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in 2012.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Personal Shopper
programme.desc: Written and directed by Olivier Assayas (Clouds of Sils Maria), Personal Shopper stars Kristen Stewart, Lars Eidinger and Anders Danielsen Lie. An ethereal and mysterious ghost story starring Kristen Stewart as a high-fashion personal shopper to the stars who is also a spiritual medium.

programme.title: Capote
programme.desc: The film for which the ill-fated Philip Seymour Hoffman won his only Oscar® for a brilliant and passionate portrayal of the famous writer Truman Capote. November 1959, Capote reads a report in the NY Times detailing the bloody murder of the four members of the Clutter family.

programme.title: England is Mine
programme.desc: In 1970's Manchester, Steven Morrissey (Jack Lowden – Dunkirk, A United Kingdom, '71), an introverted, uncompromising teenager, finds himself frustrated with his working-class existence.

programme.title: Meet The Spartans
programme.desc: A spoof of 300 (2006) and many other movies, TV series/shows/commercials, video games and celebrities. King Leonidas of Sparta and his army of 12 go to war against Xerxes of Persia to fight to the death for Sparta's freedom.

programme.title: The Negotiator
programme.desc: Caught up in a conspiracy, a top-notch negotiator ends up in a tight spot when he's falsely accused of killing his partner and stealing from the department's pension fund. To clear his name, he decides to take hostages, get help from another skilled negotiator, and uncover who's behind the whole scheme before time runs out.

programme.title: Finder's Fee
programme.desc: A man finds a wallet containing a winning lottery ticket worth $6 million.

programme.title: What We Do in the Shadows
programme.desc: Vampires vamp it up in this hilarious mock-doc. Viago, Deacon and Vladislav are vampires who are finding that modern life has them struggling with the mundane - like paying rent, keeping up with the chore wheel, trying to get into nightclubs and overcoming flatmate conflicts.

programme.title: The Internship
programme.desc: Old-school salesmen Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) try to reboot their careers by joining Google's fiercely competitive internship program — with hilarious results!

programme.title: Hellboy: The Crooked Man
programme.desc: In the 1950s, Hellboy is enlisted to aid rookie paranormal researcher, Bobbie Jo Song, in the transportation of a deadly creature. However, their mission soon goes awry when an accident leaves them stranded in the forests of rural Appalachia, where a small community resides, haunted by demonic forces. With all clues pointing towards witchcraft as the culprit, Hellboy and his allies must hunt down the source of this evil - a being known as 'The Crooked Man' who has been sent to Earth to harvest souls for the devil.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: Shutter
programme.desc: A newly married couple discovers disturbing, ghostly images in photographs they develop after an eerie accident in which they believe they may have hit a young girl with their car.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: When the White House is taken over by terrorists, a former agent must step up and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Law Abiding Citizen
programme.desc: A man decides to take justice into his own hands after a plea bargain sets one of his family's killers free.

programme.title: Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard
programme.desc: Michael Bryce continues his friendship with assassin, Darius Kincaid, as they try to save Darius' wife Sonia.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: When the White House is taken over by terrorists, a former agent must step up and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: It's a Boy Girl Thing
programme.desc: It's A Boy Girl Thing is a brilliantly funny romantic comedy about next-door neighbours who live worlds apart. Woody Deane (Zegers) and Nell Bedworth (Armstrong) are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies. In their switched identities, each sets out to destroy the other's high school reputation. When they start to succeed they get more than they bargained for. Sometimes falling in love can be an out of body experience.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Finally, after 1978's I Spit On Your Grave shocked the world with its story of a beautiful career woman assaulted and left for dead, and her notorious revenge on those responsible, cinema's most lethal Lady Vengeance returns in the most anticipated sequel of all time. Reuniting star Camille Keaton and original director Meir Zarchi, I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu sends now successful writer Jennifer Hills hurtling back to where it all began - to face the wrath of the families of those she murdered. Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

programme.title: The Working Girl
programme.desc: This slick, provocative thriller set in a more shadowy London, will have you nail-biting until its shocking climax. Cool and collected call girl, Virgine (Hafsia Herzi) has mastered the art of trading sex with wealthy businessmen for money, without getting emotionally involved. But when she meets mysterious Rupert (Ash Stymest), she becomes entangled in a deep and dangerous affair.

programme.title: Boudica
programme.desc: This historical action is the bold, bloody story of the Celtic Queen. King Prasutagus rules over the Iceni people with his wife Boudica by his side, but when he is betrayed and killed, Boudica's kingdom is left without a male heir and the Romans seize her land. Determined to avenge her husband's death, Boudica rallies the tribes from the region and wages an epic war against the Roman Empire.

programme.title: Candy Corn
programme.desc: A traveling carnival is in town for the weekend and local outcast, Jacob Atkins, has been hired as one of the freaks in the events main attraction. Meanwhile, a group of local bullies are planning their annual public hazing of Jacob, but this year things go too far

programme.title: St Agatha
programme.desc: St Agatha is a twisted horror thriller which pushes the boundaries of the nunsploitation genre from Darren Lynn Bousman, the director of Saw II, III and IV. In 1950s Georgia, a pregnant con woman on the run seeks refuge in a desolate convent only to be met with an unsettling and horrendous evil waiting on the other side. Enter this convent at your own risk!

programme.title: Welcome Home
programme.desc: Perry, a famed writer battling writers block decides to relocate to his old New York home – in hopes that getting back to his roots will help him come up with his next hit story.

programme.title: August
programme.desc: ‘Wall Street', ‘Boiler Room' and ‘Shattered Glass' come crashing into the Internet Age in this intense, edge-of-your-seat and emotional tale about one man's fight to keep his dreams alive during the dot-com collapse of 2001.

programme.title: My New York Year
programme.desc: 1990s, New York City: A recent grad and aspiring writer lands a job as assistant to renowned writer J.D. Salinger's literary agent.

programme.title: Land of the Blind
programme.desc: A razor-sharp political thriller about terrorism, revolution, and the power of memory, starring Oscar nominee Ralph Fiennes (The Grand Budapest Hotel, Schindler's List, Harry Potter), Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland (The Hunger Games, Pride & Prejudice)...

programme.title: Christmas Overtime
programme.desc: (2024) Romance with Megan Carrasquillo. A workaholic ad executive hires a charming actress to help him convince his team to finish a project on Christmas Eve, but soon finds himself falling for her.

programme.title: The Christmas Pageant
programme.desc: (2011) Festive romance starring Melissa Gilbert. A temperamental director is forced to direct a Christmas pageant. She finds herself swept up by the magic of Christmas, and an ex-lover.

programme.title: My Sweet Holiday
programme.desc: (2020) Festive romance starring Malone Thomas. When Sadie agrees to train the charming new owner of her family's chocolate shop, she gets more than a taste of holiday love.

programme.title: The Christmas Cabin
programme.desc: A city-dweller inherits a holiday cabin only to find that it has already been occupied!

programme.title: Love In Wolf Creek
programme.desc: On the verge of losing her wildlife refuge, Sam, along with the town's handsome newcomer, Austin, risk it all to save an injured white wolf.

programme.title: Nights and Weekends
programme.desc: In her directorial debut, Greta Gerwig stars as Mattie, a New York resident who over the course of a year desperately tries to navigate through the struggles of a long-distance relationship with her partner, James, who lives in Chicago.

programme.title: Say When
programme.desc: Megan (Keira Knightley) panics when her boyfriend proposes and hides out in the home of her new teenage friend Annika (Chloë Grace Moretz).

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother and daughter con team with a devious routine. Max targets wealthy men, lures them into marriage and then Page seduces them, leaving Max to discover their infidelity and reap the huge divorce settlements which tide them over until they target their next victim.

programme.title: Love Notes

programme.title: João Bosco
programme.desc: The vibrant island of Malta was in for a night of light and cheerful music when Brazilian music legend João Bosco took the stage on July 21, 2018. The self-taught guitarist made his music debut in the 1970s alongside Elis Regina and Aldir Blanc. In 2018, with guitarist Ricardo Silveira, bassist João Baptista and drummer Kiko Freitas, Bosco introduces us to his trademark melting pot of bossa nova, samba and MPB, sparingly influenced by contemporary jazz. Following his phenomenal successes in his native Brazil, the enthusiasm of the Maltese crowd underlines that João Bosco is now gradually achieving his long-overdue recognition elsewhere.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner, Avery Sharpe & Louis Hayes
programme.sub-title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner's first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson's and Art Farmer's Jazztet. He's also known for his work with the John Coltrane Quartet. Tyner's style is easily comparable to Coltrane's maximalist style of saxophone. Though a member of Coltrane's group, he was never overshadowed by the saxophonist, but complemented and even inspired Coltrane's open-minded approach. McCoy Tyner is considered one of the most influential jazz pianists of the 20th century, an honour he earned both with Coltrane and in his years of performing following Coltrane's death.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Jamie Cullum
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.sub-title: Brooks Bowman/Jazzmeia Horn, East Of The Sun
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Herbie Mann, Marc Cohen, Romero Lubambo & Paul Socolow
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1990, American flautist Herbert Jay Solomon, better known by his stage name Herbie Mann, was one of the artists appearing here. Together with Marc Cohen on piano, Romero Lubambo on guitar, Paul Socolow on bass, and both Ricky Sebastian and Cyro Baptista on percussion, Herbie Mann performs his infectious take on Brazilian-inspired music in this concert titled 'Jasil Brazz'.

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan, Richard Davis, Ronnell Bright & Art Morgan
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 & 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic. These three performances demonstrate why Sarah Vaughan is invariably mentioned in the same breath as Ella Fitzgerald and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
programme.sub-title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: Valery Gergiev
programme.desc: This visually stunning production of Nutcracker is a graceful and timeless adventure on a grand scale. From the lovely Waltz of the Flowers to the crystalline beauty of the stunning Snowflake Waltz, each scene is more breathtaking than the last, bringing to life all the well-known and beloved characters with fresh sparkle and compelling originality. It is Christmas Eve and we are brought to a party at which Drosselmeyer gives young Clara a nutcracker doll - beginning a night that includes a magically growing Christmas tree, a midnight battle of toy soldiers at which the Nutcracker defeats the villainous Mouse King and his army of mice, and a headlong pas de deux in which Clara and Hans-Peter meet and celebrate their triumph before being enveloped in a magical snowstorm. Act II whisks the young pair off to the Kingdom of the Sweets, where they are entertained by the Sugar Plum Fairy with her handsome Prince and her glittering court in a series of dazzling dances. Under the direction of Andreas Morell, Valery Gergiev conducts the Mariinsky Orchestra and Choir. Soloists are Mikhail Makarov, lldar Abdrazakov, Anna Markarova, Sergei Skorokhodov, Timur Abdikeyev, Vladislav Sulimasky. This production was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in 2012.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Heart
programme.sub-title: Live At The Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: This film captures not only Heart's first-ever live performance at the Royal Albert Hall but is also the first concert film of Heart performing with a full orchestra. Live At The Royal Albert Hall With The Royal Philharmonic Orchestra includes chart-topping songs like “These Dreams”, “Alone”, “What About Love”, “Barracuda”, “Magic Man”, “Dreamboat Annie”, and more!

programme.title: J Balvin
programme.desc: J. Balvin returns to his hometown of Medellín, Colombia to perform a special anniversary concert entitled "BRUUTTAL". A musical journey that begins with his early songs and ends with his most recent, multi-platinum album, " Energía.” This spectacular show was performed and filmed to express J. Balvin's gratitude to his fans. J. Balvin succeeded in making this one-time show spectacular by assembling other Latin urban music legends including Nicky Jam, Yandel, Farruko, Zion y Lennox, Jowell y Randy, among others, to join him on stage. J. Balvin sang his hit songs “6 AM,” “Safari,” “Ginza,” and “Ay Vamos.”

programme.title: Toto
programme.desc: This concert was recorded at Le Zenith in Paris in March 2007 in front of a wildly enthusiastic sell-out crowd. It captures Toto rocking at their hardest and most powerful and giving a new life to all their best loved tracks. The band formed in LA in the late 70's by a group of friends who were all much in demand session musicians. They went on to epitomize the classic American pop/rock sound of the 80's and 90's with hit albums and singles including Hold The Line, Africa, I'll Be Over You and the multi-Grammy winning worldwide hit Rosanna.

programme.title: La venganza es mía
programme.desc: Iwao Enokizu es un hombre de mediana edad que tiene una necesidad inexplicable de cometer asesinatos con una violencia demencial. Toda la policía de Japón le persigue, pero siempre logra escapar. Iwao desprecia a sus padres y esposa. Un día conoce a una mujer que trabaja en un burdel, y los dos se enamoran... Se quieren pero nunca saben cuanto tiempo pueden estar juntos.

programme.desc: Tras el robo a una partida ilegal de póker, la mafia contrata a un asesino profesional para encontrar a los culpables y restablecer el orden en el mundo del crimen.

programme.desc: Nueva York, años ochenta. Astoria, en el barrio de Queens, es un sitio duro para crecer. Los adolescentes se pasan el día peleándose, sobre todo los puertorriqueños con los italianos. Por otra parte, las hormonas están en plena revolución.

programme.title: La Bahía Del Silencio
programme.desc: La repentina desaparición de su esposa e hijos lleva a Will a una búsqueda frenética por Europa.

programme.title: Los Hijos de Allen Funt

programme.title: El Tren de las 3:10
programme.desc: Un veterano de Guerra escolta al peligroso forajido Ben Wade para aliviar sus penurias económicas.

programme.desc: ¡Tom y Jerry viajan en el tiempo! Tras una loca persecución en el Museo Metropolitan de Nueva York, un portal del tiempo los transporta a una ciudad dorada inspirada en la Antigua China, llena de magia, guerreros y criaturas sorprendentes.

programme.title: El único superviviente
programme.desc: Espectacular adaptación cinematográfica de las memorias del ex-marine Marcus Luttrell en las que relata su experiencia en la misión de 2005 en Afganistán, donde le encomendaron liquidar a un líder terrorista en lo que se considera uno de los mayores actos de valor de la guerra moderna.

programme.title: Insidious: Capítulo 3
programme.desc: En esta tercera entrega de la saga, Elise Rainier acepta a utilizar su capacidad de ponerse en contacto con los muertos a fin de ayudar a una adolescente que se ha convertido en el blanco de una peligrosa entidad sobrenatural.

programme.title: Territorio hostil
programme.desc: En los Estados Unidos posteriores a la guerra civil, cuando se presume que un soldado de la Unión está muerto, sus hijos son enviados por error en el tren de los huérfanos.

programme.title: Hermosas criaturas
programme.desc: Siguiendo la línea de 'Crepúsculo', 'Hermosas criaturas' es un cuento de amores contrariados que esconde un oscuro y peligroso secreto. Ethan Wate es un adolescente que sueña con escapar de su rutinaria vida en la pequeña localidad de Gatlin, hasta que conoce a Lena Duchannes.

programme.title: Big Eyes
programme.desc: 'Big Eyes' está basada en la historia real de Walter Keane, uno de los pintores más exitosos de los años 50. El artista alcanzó una notoriedad asombrosa con sus enigmáticas pinturas de niños abandonados con grandes ojos. La autora era Margaret, su mujer, pero en realidad los firmaba Walter.

programme.title: Hierro 3
programme.desc: Tae-suk, un joven que ocupa temporalmente casas vacías, conoce a Sun-hwa, una mujer maltratada por su marido. Intrigada, ella se une a su vida errante. Al ser descubiertos, él es encarcelado y ella vuelve a casa. Tras salir de la cárcel, su primer paso es buscar a Sun-hwa.

programme.title: Fish Tank
programme.desc: Mia, una adolescente frustrada y solitaria de 15 años, huérfana de padre y cuya madre apenas se ocupa de ella, se enfada cuando se entera de que ésta sale con un hombre, el atractivo Connor.

programme.title: Navidad Vuelve A Casa
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de su amor de la infancia y de su hijo de seis años, Abbey redescubre su espíritu navideño

programme.title: La promesa
programme.desc: Romance prohibido en la Alemania prebélica.

programme.title: Cariño, cuánto te odio
programme.desc: Rivales laborales descubren el amor.

programme.title: Juegos de la Vida
programme.desc: Una pareja humilde en La Habana decide regalarse algo especial por su aniversario.

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Rob es un reconocido chef de Londres, su carrera es un éxito y la vida le sonríe hasta que un accidente acaba con la vida de su esposa. Superado por la tristeza, Rob pierde su restaurante y su interés por la cocina, hasta que animado por un grupo de amigos y su hija, decide empezar de nuevo.

programme.title: Fresa y chocolate
programme.desc: David es un comunista convencido que estudia sociología en la Universidad de La Habana. Diego es un artista homosexual acosado por la homofobia del régimen castrista. A pesar de las abismales diferencias que los separan, entre ellos surge una profunda amistad.

programme.title: Más fuerte que su destino
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XVI, las amantes de los hombres importantes de Venecia llevaban una vida muy majestuosa y se las animaba a leer y estudiar en una época en la que ese tipo de educación estaba prohibida para la mayoría de mujeres.

programme.title: Amar
programme.desc: Una de las óperas primas más estimulantes y reveladoras del año. El talento de Esteban Crespo, nominado al Oscar por el cortometraje "Aquel no era yo" se confirma con esta película de amores tan intensos que se viven como si cada día fuera el último.

programme.title: Pterodactyl
programme.desc: Un volcán inactivo en las profundidades de un bosque en Turquía guarda un secreto mortal: un nido de huevos de Pterodactyl perfectamente conservados y listos para salir del cascarón. Pronto el pasado y el presente colapsan, provocando nefastas consecuencias para la humanidad. Una unidad militar de operaciones especiales será quien luchará contra el enemigo prehistórico.

programme.title: Mercenary
programme.desc: Jonas Ambler es un rico hombre de negocios cuya esposa es asesinada por un comando terrorista.

programme.title: Turbo Kid
programme.desc: Es el año 1997. La tierra ha sido devastada por la lluvia ácida y el agua se ha convertido en un bien escaso. The Kid sobrevive solo en su búnker subterráneo, obsesionado por los cómics y deambulando con su bicicleta para encontrar reliquias del viejo mundo. Conocer a una chica llamada Apple le descubrirá el verdadero sentido de la justicia, el valor y la amistad.

programme.title: Soldado
programme.desc: Waxman y Clegg son dos asesinos a sueldo de una agencia gubernamental secreta que esperan la llegada de su víctima en un rascacielos desértico. Pero Waxman ha empezado a tener serias dudas sobre lo que hace y, mientras espera, recuerda trabajos pasados y sus escrúpulos van en aumento. Cuando la misión sale mal, Waxman y su compañero se convierten en los principales objetivos de la agencia.

programme.title: Vidas Criminales
programme.desc: Secuestro se complica cuando el esposo no paga.

programme.title: Una nueva vida
programme.desc: Tras perder a su esposa, Bill y su hijo comienzan de nuevo en California con ayuda de dos mujeres.

programme.title: V.O.S
programme.desc: Un juego entre dos parejas, entre cuatro personajes. Cuatro visiones de una misma historia.

programme.title: Concursante
programme.desc: Martín Circo Martín, acaba de convertirse en el ganador del mayor premio de la historia de la televisión.

programme.title: Kaplan
programme.desc: Irritado por su vejez y aburrido de su monótona vida, Jacobo Kaplan es invadido por la angustia del olvido.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: La retorcidas mentes de dos de los seis guionistas de Scary Movie dan una vuelta de tuerca al género de la comedia romántica en DATE MOVIE.

programme.title: Casi 300
programme.desc: Prepárate para combatir... las ganas de llorar de risa delante de esta increíblemente divertida versión “a muerte” de Casi 300 con secuencias todavía más hilarantes, se acompañadas con una legión de carcajeantes extras que harán historia.

programme.title: Diario de un ejecutivo agresivo
programme.desc: Jack es un agente literario con una exitosa trayectoria profesional. De repente su vida da un vuelco: se entera de que su mujer lo engaña con su mejor cliente, le roban en su casa y le dan una paliza.

programme.title: Ejecutivo Agresivo
programme.desc: El empresario Dave Buznik es normalmente afable y nada polémico. Pero tras un altercado a bordo de un avión, es condenado a participar en un programa de gestión de la ira. Allí descubre que su propio instructor, el Dr. Buddy Rydell, tiene un grave problema de ira, un problema que solo se revelará del todo después de que el doctor se traslade a casa de Dave para darle lecciones prácticas sobre "comportamiento calmado".

programme.title: El Pelotón Chiflado
programme.desc: Cuando John Winger pierde su apartamento, su novia y su trabajo en un mismo día, hace lo que cualquier americano que se precie: se alista en el ejército y casi provoca la 3ª Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Él es el mejor que existe, de hecho, ¡él es el único! Él es Ace Ventura: Detective de mascotas, dedicado a encontrar a la mascota y mariscal de campo de los Miami Dolphins, Dan Marino. Se enfrentará frente a frente con un tiburón devora-hombres, vigilará a los Miami Dolphins y coqueteará con las chicas. Encubierto, abaleado o bajo el agua, siempre consigue a su hombre… o bestia.

programme.title: En Qué Piensan Los Hombres 2
programme.desc: Volvieron todas las parejas para una boda en Las Vegas, pero los planes para un fin de semana romántico salen mal cuando las varias desventuras que tienen los dejan en situaciones comprometedoras que amenazan con descarrilar el gran evento.

programme.title: Tormenta en Arizona
programme.desc: Película de vaqueros publicada en 1956 dirigida por Joseph Kane y protagonizada por Skip Homeier: Tomenta en Arizona - Se descubre una rica veta de mineral en una mina de plata cerca de un pequeño pueblo. El corrupto alcalde casi consigue hacerse con el control de la mina.

programme.title: El rifle de Kentucky
programme.desc: Mientras la caravana avanza, algunas personas se quedan atrás para reparar una carreta llena de rifles inutilizada, pero tienen que enfrentarse al ego de los demás y a los agresivos comanches que exigen los rifles como pago por el paso seguro.

programme.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
programme.desc: Un misterioso pistolero ruso ayuda a un marshal y a un sheriff en un enfrentamiento con una sanguinaria banda de forajidos conocida como Los Sabuesos del Infierno, que han invadido su pequeño pueblo del este de Texas.

programme.title: Sitting Bull: Casta de guerreros
programme.desc: Sitting Bull, líder de los Sioux, se ve obligado por el general Custer a reaccionar violentamente, lo que lleva a la famosa batalla en Little Bighorn. Parrish, un amigo de los Sioux, intenta evitar la sangre derramada pero es acusado de colaborar con el enemigo. Sitting Bull intercede ante el presidente Grant para salvarlo.

programme.title: Dónde diablos está el oro
programme.desc: En 1895, los forajidos Cross y Boone se ven obligados a llevar a las autoridades mexicanas su botín. Viajan hasta allí en un tren lleno de dinamita con un grupo de prostitutas. Los rebeldes mexicanos, los indios y los agentes de la Wells Fargo les persiguen.

programme.title: Some Be
programme.desc: Tras la aparición de un virus que elimina la voluntad y la conciencia, la sociedad colapsa. En medio del caos, Esteban y Sarah deben luchar por sobrevivir, enfrentándose no solo al peligro del contagio, sino también a lo que queda de la humanidad.

programme.title: Devuélveme La Vida
programme.desc: Una jovencita lucha sin cesar para salvar a su madre drogadicta de un peligroso inframundo mientras el Departamento de la Policía de Los Ángeles lucha por destruir ese mundo.

programme.title: The Employer
programme.desc: Cinco aspirantes altamente cualificados se entrevistan para un codiciado puesto de trabajo. La noche anterior a la última ronda de entrevistas, todos son secuestrados y drogados. Al día siguiente, se despiertan atrapados juntos en una habitación cerrada sin ninguna esperanza de escapar.

programme.title: Los héroes de las Ardenas
programme.desc: La historia real de la heroica experiencia de Don Smith en la Batalla de las Ardenas, cuando formaba parte del 94º de Infantería.

programme.title: La Última Noticia
programme.desc: Un locutor de radio peruano arriesga su vida para informar sobre los enfrentamientos entre la policía y la guerrilla.

programme.title: Prácticamente muerto
programme.desc: Clahan es un sacerdote protestante que dirige a un grupo de fanáticos de la supremacía blanca. Un día, durante un sermón, es asesinado por un extremista de izquierdas. Su inconsolable viuda, dispuesta a vengarse, busca la ayuda de dos fanáticos, que secuestran y torturan a un hombre al que creen culpable.

programme.title: Cuando cae la nieve
programme.desc: 1950, Moscú. La comunista Katya (Rebecca Ferguson) es una espía del gobierno americano en plena carrera armamentística de la Guerra Fría. Cuando le asignan su misión más importante, conseguir información secreta de la joven promesa del gobierno ruso, Alexander (Sam Reid, Charles Dance), lo último que espera es que va a enamorarse de él. Intentar conciliar su pasión hacia a él con su rechazo al comunismo la llevará a hacer el mayor de los sacrificios, un gesto que Alexander descubrirá treinta años más tarde.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Dos amigos judíos de edad avanzada (Allen y Turturro) se encuentran ante una desesperada situación financiera. Deciden entonces probar suerte con el negocio de la prostitución masculina, uno como gigoló y el otro como "representante". Pero el asunto no será bien visto en la comunidad judía en la que viven.

programme.title: The convent. El convento del diablo
programme.desc: El colegio femenino de St. Francis fue cerrado hace décadas debido a una horrible historia que allí sucedió. Una joven llamada Christine al parecer asesinó a varias monjas y un sacerdote, y ahora vive aislada en una de las casas del pueblo. El convento sirve de marco para innumerables leyendas, y tradiciones como pintar las letras del colegio en la torre antes de comenzar el juego de la hermandad escolar. Un grupo de amigos decide ir al viejo edificio para realizar la pintada y de paso tener allí una pequeña fiesta. Pero aparece una pareja de policías, y los jóvenes deben irse del lugar, dejando allí sola a una de las chicas. Cuando regresen, se encontrarán con que terribles fuerzas habitan el lugar...

programme.title: Mi gran despedida
programme.desc: Tres amores: el de Puri, dispuesta a hacer lo posible y lo imposible por dejar las cosas claras con su novio el de Milagro, que guarda más secretos de los que su naturaleza le permite, y el de Sara, cuya inminente boda reúne a un variopinto grupo de mujeres para festejar su compromiso.

programme.title: Animales Heridos
programme.desc: Historias que se cruzan sobre parejas, la soledad y las heridas del amor.

programme.title: Amar
programme.desc: Una de las óperas primas más estimulantes y reveladoras del año. El talento de Esteban Crespo, nominado al Oscar por el cortometraje "Aquel no era yo" se confirma con esta película de amores tan intensos que se viven como si cada día fuera el último.

programme.title: El lute: Camina o revienta
programme.desc: Eleuterio Sánchez “El Lute” aprovecha un traslado para fugarse. Desde ese momento, será perseguido por la Guardia Civil.

programme.title: Los 28 hombres de Panfilov
programme.desc: Rusia, noviembre 1941. Las tropas alemanas se acercan a Moscú. En los alrededores de la ciudad un grupo de 28 soldados del Ejército Rojo de la división 316, bajo el mando del general Ivan Panfilov, trata de detener el avance de la 11 División Panzer, compuesta por 54 tanques y numerosas tropas del ejército nazi.

programme.title: La Rusa
programme.desc: Tito es un hombre de 50 anos que atraviesa una crisis personal y decide regresar a su ciudad. Cuando llega, se encuentra con un pueblo mucho mas tranquilo y deprimido, dominado por la familia Crespo.

programme.title: Un misterio para Aurora Teagarden: Un monton de problemas
programme.desc: Aurora Teagarden empieza a alarmarse cuando desaparece la sobrina de Martin Bartell y encuentran a su bebe escondido en una banera.

programme.title: Phantom Halo
programme.desc: A scheme for making easy money goes awry when a young man turns to counterfeiting to repay his father's debts.

programme.title: Asesino de tiburones
programme.desc: Los servicios del asesino de tiburones Chase Walker han sido contratados por su hermano Jake, jefe de una banda criminal de la Costa Oeste. El trabajo: matar al tiburón de aleta negra que se tragó un valioso diamante durante una transacción entre bandas. Para vigilar a Chase, se alista a Jasmine, colega de Jake. Pero la relación entre Chase y Jasmine se profundiza con las amenazas de un jefe rival: llevarle el diamante o morir. Pronto, las lealtades cambiarán, y Chase aprenderá que confiar en la sangre es para tontos. Ahora, se enfrentan jefes contra jefes, hermanos contra hermanos y el hombre contra la naturaleza, mientras Chase se esfuerza por rescatar a Jasmine, salvar su propia vida y rastrear al gran tiburón de aleta negra que será el mayor desafío de su carrera.

programme.title: En primera línea
programme.desc: Situé au Viêt Nam en avril 1968, trois mois après l'offensive du Têt et un mois après l'assassinat de Martin Luther King Jr, Point Man raconte l'histoire d'une équipe de pompiers de l'armée américaine fracturée par les tensions raciales, les crises morales et les pressions écrasantes du combat dans une guerre que personne ne veut mener. Andre « Casper » Allen, un idéologue brutal, est en désaccord avec Silas Meeks, le mitrailleur de l'escouade, en raison de ses idées radicales. Lorsque leur mission de recherche et de destruction dans le delta du Mékong tourne mal, les deux hommes se retrouvent opposés l'un à l'autre et à leur chef de section récalcitrant, le lieutenant Sutter. Les hommes de pointe meurent comme des mouches dans la brousse, et à mesure que les loyautés se dissolvent, chaque pas en avant a un prix.

programme.title: El joven detective Dee
programme.desc: China, año 665 d.C. La dinastía Tang está siendo amenazada por el reino coreano de Buyeo. Por ello, se envían barcos de guerra como advertencia. Sin embargo, la flota queda reducida a cenizas antes de llegar a su destino, supuestamente por el ataque del Dragón del Mar. La emperatriz ordena resolver el misterio de la desaparición de la flota de forma inmediata. El joven Dee llega ese mismo día para ocupar un puesto en el Departamento de Justicia.

programme.title: Catástrofe Inminente
programme.desc: Una gran oleada de asteroides atraviesa el Sistema Solar provocando que la Tierra salga de su órbita y sufriendo una gran devastación. La única oportunidad para los supervivientes es que la fuerza del Sol recupere el control sobre la Tierra pero, aunque lo haga, la vida en el planeta habrá cambiado para siempre. Si alguien te dijera que el mundo se acabará mañana, ¿le creerías?

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: Un mensajero de Nueva York (Taylor Lautner) se ve envuelto en una trama criminal. 'Tracers' está ambientada en el espectacular mundo del parkour, una técnica de desplazamiento en la que hay que superar todos los obstáculos usando las habilidades del cuerpo humano: saltando vallas, muros, etc.

programme.title: Cruzando el límite (2013)
programme.desc: Un thriller británico seguro, ambicioso y lleno de acción. El detective Max Lewinsky, queda física y emocionalmente destrozado cuando, durante una persecución en Londres, el conocido criminal Jacob Sternwood se le escapa de las manos. Tres años después vuelve a intentar atraparlo.

programme.title: El origen del justiciero
programme.desc: Zaid, un exitoso doctor, ve como su hermano pequeño muere en un asalto relacionado con una peligrosa banda criminal. Corroído por la rabia, abandonará su privilegiada vida para convertirse en un justiciero enmascarado y vengar la muerte de su hermano dando caza a todos...

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
